description: Defines the PlayerComponents class and its nested Factory class, which manage media stack components such as audio/video renderers, decoders, and media time providers for a media player framework. It includes creation parameters, support checks, and component accessors.

classes.name: PlayerComponents
classes.description: Manages media stack components like renderers, decoders, and media time providers for media playback.

classes.name: PlayerComponents::Factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating PlayerComponents instances, with support checks and subcomponent creation methods.

classes.name: PlayerComponents::CreationParameters
classes.description: Holds parameters for creating media components, including stream info, DRM, and output mode.

methods.name: GetMediaTimeProvider
methods.description: Returns the media time provider component.
